facts.fact: Ares 承认自己在暗处看着 Clay 掐住 Kayla 的脖子，并在她即将昏过去的最后一刻现身出手干预；Ares 认定 Clay 一旦上头就会失控，并打算利用这一点。
facts.anchor: Clay didn’t know I was watching when he wrapped his hand around her throat, neither the first nor the second time.

facts.fact: Ares 打电话给 Cipher，Cipher 带来打磨机把 Kayla 和 Vero 身上的镣铐打开，Vero 对此很不爽。
facts.anchor: I called Cipher, knowing he would have a way to remove the cuffs—he is always tinkering with something.

facts.fact: Kayla 醒来发现手腕被铐得红肿，并直接问是不是 Ares 救了自己；Ares 点头承认，只解释自己被 scarecrow（Cave）耽搁。
facts.anchor: It was you who saved me, wasn’t it?”

facts.fact: Vero 用厨房里所有锅做炒蛋、把面粉弄得到处都是甚至弄上天花板，自嘲说下次保证不再把自己和她铐在一起。
facts.anchor: You know, next time I promise not to handcuff myself to you.

facts.fact: Jess 冲进厨房看到 Kayla 就要她远离“Kyle”，还指责她打电话骚扰 Clay；Clay 站在妹妹身后全程不吭声，让妹妹主导。
facts.anchor: You need to stay away from Kyle.”

facts.fact: Kayla 把手机递给 Jess，亮出存成“Douchenugget”的联系方式和消息/通话记录，证明打电话骚扰 Clay 的不是她，而是 Clay 因为被劈腿而怀恨在心。
facts.anchor: His name is saved under Douchenugget. Look at our message history—check the call logs.”

facts.fact: Jess 相信了 Kayla 并哭着道歉，Clay 把妹妹拉进怀里，兄弟俩对 Kayla 的敌意随之瓦解。
facts.anchor: I feel so fucking stupid,” Jess cries into her brother’s chest.

facts.fact: Clay 告诉 Kayla：若 Kyle 再出现在酒吧就打电话给他，因为他打算杀了 Kyle；Kayla 拒绝以杀人报复，只想泼牛奶或打电话剧透。
